en.title: Profit boost for KB Components

en.title: The Riksbank's head of IT flew business class for SEK 120,000

en.title: Broad agreement on climate goals – but disagreement on the path there
en.summary: When a new government takes office, there will be a rush to restructure in order not to miss the climate goals. That is why the inquiry “The path towards phase-out” (SOU 2026:33), popularly known as the Policy Instruments Inquiry, is absolutely central.
